brave-search.description: Live web search. Use to find statistics, datasets, news, and domain context. Essential for grounding the AI in real-world numbers during the hackathon.

fetch.description: Fetches and converts any URL to clean markdown text. Use to read Kaggle dataset pages, government data portals, or research paper abstracts.

sqlite.description: Run SQL queries on the local SQLite database. Use when data has been loaded via the data pipeline and you need fast aggregation queries.

github.description: Search GitHub repos, read existing implementations, and create issues. Use to find boilerplate code for similar data science projects.

filesystem.description: Read and write files in the workspace. Agents use this to read CONTEXT.md, SKILL.md files, and write generated code to src/.

memory.description: Persistent key-value memory across sessions. Store discovered dataset URLs, API keys tested, and architectural decisions so agents remember them.

sequential-thinking.description: Forces the AI to think step-by-step before answering. Use when debugging complex pipeline errors or architectural decisions.

kaggle.description: Search and download Kaggle datasets and kernels directly. Use during the Data Hunter phase to find domain-specific CSVs.
